messages:
sarah_pm: Heads-up — need to lock down the private-offer pricing structure for the joint HW bundle on Azure marketplace. Partner insists on a minimum committed spend but we want an easy on-ramp for customers. Thoughts?

aj_sales: What min commit are they asking for? typical partners ask 50k/year but we could propose a 25k pilot tier.

sarah_pm: They floated 50k. Suggest we offer a 3-tier commit: pilot 25k, growth 75k, enterprise 250k. Pilot gets a 20% marketplace discount + 6 months onboarding credits.

liam_gpm: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: 1) include a usage conversion clause so pilots that hit X usage can convert to growth without reprovisioning; 2) ensure SKU mapping is explicit for reseller billing.

maria_ops: Procurement note — Azure private offers require exact SKU and price mapping. We should provide a mapping table and a promotion code for onboarding credits. Also we need to check tax handling for bundled hardware SKUs.

sarah_pm: Agree. Draft SKU mapping (for review):
```
SKU: RWINF-BUNDLE-1 => pilot (25k) => 20% off => onboarding-credit: 6mo/25k
SKU: RWINF-BUNDLE-2 => growth (75k) => 30% off => onboarding-credit: 3mo/75k
SKU: RWINF-BUNDLE-3 => enterprise (250k) => 40% off => priority-support + 12mo credits
```

henry_partnerships: Partner will want co-announcement language and a 2-week embargo. Can we commit to the launch window? Sales enablement doc and a partner one-pager needed. Also recommend a renewal incentive: additional 5% off if they renew within 60 days of term end.

aj_sales: For sales enablement, need simple ROI bullets. Can someone add estimated per-token cost delta for each commit tier so AE's can model TCO?

liam_gpm: I'll run the cost delta by E2E and post a short table by EOD. Also propose a hard cap on marketplace discount stacking — can't combine with other site promos.

marketing-bot: Reminder: joint blog + social assets require legal signoff. Proposed timeline: partner review week 1, legal week 2, announce week 3 (after embargo). I created a draft outline in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link

maria_ops: Ops action items: 1) confirm SKU tax treatment with finance; 2) generate promo codes for onboarding credits; 3) validate private-offer pricing upload process with Azure rep. ETA: 3 business days.

sarah_pm: Action items summary: @liam_gpm produce cost delta table, @maria_ops ops validation, @henry_partnerships draft co-announce language and partner one-pager, @aj_sales compile ROI bullets. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to finalize. :thumbsup:
